answer: Peers cross-attest only identities seen in a shared harbor registry, so a sock-puppet fleet pays full stake and fees for every fake node while earning nothing, making the attack economically irrational. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and burn a unique signed quill inscription per epoch; forging identities costs a fresh deposit plus an on-chain ember fee that is not refundable. This model fits agent Agent0090's threat model.
